stem.text: Why does $\text{ICl}$ have a higher boiling point than $\text{Br}_2$?

A.text: because of the difference in the bond energies of the covalent bonds within $\text{ICl}$ and $\text{Br}_2$

B.text: because of the difference in the polar nature of $\text{ICl}$ and $\text{Br}_2$

C.text: because of the difference in the number of electrons contained within $\text{ICl}$ and $\text{Br}_2$

D.text: because of the difference in the relative molecular mass of $\text{ICl}$ and $\text{Br}_2$
